description: Verifies raw.security.setIgnoreCertificateErrors by issuing raw CDP command(s) Security.setIgnoreCertificateErrors against an about:blank page. It passes when every non-optional CDP step completes without a protocol error. Optional steps are best-effort, and returned values are not graded. The Security-domain command is sent over the page-target transport.
title: raw.security.setIgnoreCertificateErrors
